stories.title: Brody Watch!
stories.text: Brody was EVERYWHERE during the draft! Every time anyone looked up, there he was — making another pick and keeping everyone on their toes. The draft board just could not stop hearing from Brody!

stories.title: Amanda's Picks, Please!
stories.text: Amanda kept asking, "wait, why did someone take MY pick again?!" It seemed like the players she wanted kept zooming away right before her turn. Don't worry Amanda — the draft board heard you, but it was too busy picking!
